GENERAL PASSENGER INFORMATION
BAGGAGE - Free Allowance - DOMESTIC (USA & Canada) - 40
pounds; INTERNATIONAL - 66 pounds. Baggage in excess of the
above free allowance will be charged at the published tariff rates.
CHECK-IN - Passengers must check in at the boarding gate or
station at least 15 minutes prior to the scheduled departure time,
or the passenger's reservation can be cancelled and made avall
able to anyone else standing by.
ONNECTING TIMES - S. F. Airport: Domestic - Helicopter t
AL and TWA, 15 minutes. To others, 20 minutes. From AAL, an
TWA to helicopter, 20 minutes. From others, 30 minutes. Interna-
tional - Helicopter to all 1 hour. All to helicopter (with Customs)
1 hour 30 minutes, (without Customs) 1 hour.
Oakland Airport: Domestic - All carriers
to and from helicopter 20 minutes. International - 1 hour.
CREDIT CARDS - Convenient American Express, Bank Americard,
Carte Blanche, Diner's, First National Bank of San Jose, Master
Charge Universal Air Travel Plan (UATP) or SFO Helicopter Air-
lines Credit Card are honored at all SFO ticket counters.
HELICOPTER CARRIERS - We suggest our passengers use the
scheduled helicopter
services of ANSETT - A. N. A., BRITISH
EUROPEAN AIRWAYS CORP., LOS ANGELES AIRWAYS, INC.,
NEW YORK AIRWAYS, INC., and PAKISTAN INTERNATIONAL
AIRLINES.
SCHEDULES - Schedules show the time at which flights may be
expected to arrive or depart, - but SFO Helicopter Airlines will
not be responsible for consequences arising from delays or from
rrors in the printed schedule. Times shown are subject to chang
vithout notice. SFO Schedules are included in the San Francisco
listing of the North American Quick Reference Edition (QRE) of the
Official Airline Guide (OAG), in table 325 of the OAG and in table
1756 of the ABC World Airways Guide.

The City Heliport - Now under construction at the foot of Market St.
in San Francisco,
this attractive heliport will be completed in De
cember of 1967. SFO Helicopter will then provide fast, frequent
service between THE CITY and the San Francisco International
Airport as well as Berkeley and Marin County. Passengers will be
able to measure the distance to hotel and business in blocks rather
than miles. The same excellent parking facilities, baggage check-
thru and low connecting fares that have made SFO Helicopter synon-
ymous with convenience in the San Francisco Bay Area will be avail-
able. We look forward to serving you soon.
